nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Night air. City lights like a circuit board. Lord Voss holds court beside a stone balustrade; Sera Kade laughs at something that wasn't a joke.

choices.text: Sera Kade saw you. Pretend you meant to.

nodes.speaker: edrin_voss
nodes.text: Trade liaison, yes? Orth. Tell me — do freighters still lie on paper, or have we automated the dishonesty?

faculty_interjections.text: He's testing for competence and nerve. Answer both.

choices.text: We've automated the paperwork. The lying still needs artisans.
I only reconcile what I'm given, my lord.

nodes.speaker: edrin_voss
nodes.text: Artisans. Delightful. Stay interesting, Orth — porcelain cracks when it's boring.

effects.summary: Voss likes interesting people; hates boredom.

nodes.speaker: edrin_voss
nodes.text: Then you are furniture. Furniture may leave.

nodes.speaker: sera_kade
nodes.text: Cassian Orth. What a carefully chosen surname. Don't worry — I'm only here for the canapés. And whatever you're here for.

faculty_interjections.text: Rival. Charming knife. Do not bleed in public.

choices.text: Canapés, then. I hear the study has better lighting.
I'm here for policy small-talk. Terrifying, I know.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You leave the night air to people who collect it.
